_comment: Single source of truth for the app's visual brand. Run `python3 packaging/brand.py` after editing to regenerate icons and propagate the values into the source tree. Product NAME strings in Rust stay literals (they are translatable UI text); this file covers the things that are mechanical: icons, app id, accent colour.
name: Iridium Docs
_icon_comment: The master artwork. Point `icon_svg` at any SVG and the script re-renders every size (hicolor PNGs, macOS .icns, Windows .ico, the 1024 and macOS-512 PNGs) and renames the files to match `slug`/`app_id`. Keep the viewBox 0 0 512 512; the macOS variant is derived from it.
